title: bizzi wire protocol
description: Generated from packages/protocol/src by scripts/gen-schema.ts; do not edit. The root schema validates one WebSocket text frame (ClientMsg or ServerMsg). x-methods and x-events index the per-method and per-event $defs.

subscribe.description: Replays events with seq > since (default 0), then streams live ones.

machine.set.description: Set a machine's user-owned fields (knowledge.md §9.1–9.2, spec §11.1): `tags` replaces the list, `description` replaces the text (`''` clears it), `color` sets the identity color (`''` clears it), `keepAwake` changes the given keep-awake fields (spec §8.1). Emits `machine.updated`.

agents.models.description: The models an agent offers on this machine (from the agent itself where it can say; its capability's fixed list otherwise). Cached per agent version; `refresh` asks again. An empty list means the agent can't list them: clients fall back to a free-text model field.

workspace.create.description: Adopt an existing directory, or create it when `create` is true.

workspace.remove.description: Removes the workspace from bizzi's registry only; files are untouched.

worktree.create.description: `git worktree add` + a new workspace (kind 'worktree') grouped under the repo workspace. Creates `branch` from `base` (default HEAD) unless it already exists.

worktree.remove.description: Removes the worktree and its workspace. Never deletes the branch; refuses on uncommitted changes unless `force`.

session.fork.description: New session continuing from the source session's conversation (agent-native fork when supported).

session.delete.description: Stop the session if needed and remove it and its events.

session.markSeen.description: Record that the user has seen the session through `seq` (spec §4 `seen_through`). Never moves backwards.

session.restart.description: Restart the agent process on the installed version at the next safe point and resume (updates.md §5).

session.reopen.description: Reopen an ended session: it is `idle` again, keeps its history, and the next message starts the agent, resuming the conversation when the agent can. Helpers stopped with it stay ended. A no-op on a session that isn't ended.

session.clear.description: Start a fresh conversation in the same session (`/clear`): the agent process is stopped and the next one starts without resuming, so the agent forgets everything so far. The timeline, budget and settings stay. Emits `context.cleared`. `conflict` while a turn runs; `unsupported` for terminal sessions (type the agent's own command there).

session.set.description: A helper's permission mode can't be loosened beyond its parent's (`conflict`). `budget` replaces the session's budget (`{}` clears it); a session held for budget accepts sends again once within it. / /** Change a session's settings. `title` renames it (also on an ended session; '' clears it); a title set here is kept over titles the agent reports later.

term.snapshot.description: Recent terminal output (scrollback) as of `seq`; subscribe with `since: seq` to continue live.

fs.browse.description: Workspace picker (spec §5.2, §10): list the directories in `path` on the machine (default: the node user's home; `~` and `~/…` are expanded). Unlike fs.list this is not confined to a workspace: it runs as the node's OS user, the same trust as a terminal session. Directories and symlinks to directories only; file contents are never read. `truncated` when the listing hit the node's entry cap.

fs.complete.description: Shell-like directory completion of a partially typed absolute path (`~/re` → `repo`). `base` is the typed directory part (`~/`), so a completion's full text is `base + name + '/'`. Matches that keep the typed case come first; matching ignores case on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS, Windows). Hidden directories only when `showHidden` or the typed name starts with '.'. `limit` default 50.

fs.suggest.description: Starting points for the picker: home, common source roots that exist (~/src, ~/repo, ~/code, …), parents of existing workspaces, and git repositories one level under those that aren't workspaces yet.

agent.plan.description: Preview the steps for installing / updating / uninstalling an agent.

agent.install.description: Run a plan; progress streams as `install.progress` (global channel) with this jobId.

agent.login.description: Start a login flow as a terminal-mode session; it emits `login.prompt` / `login.completed`.

agent.setSecret.description: Store a secret (e.g. an API key) on the machine; injected into that agent's environment.

agent.migrate.description: Switch an adopted install to the recipe's preferred method (spec §7): install with the preferred method, check PATH order, re-probe login, remove the old install once no session uses it.

usage.list.description: Per-login usage; on a hub, merged across machines per account.

widgets.list.description: On a hub without machineId: every online machine's widgets.

baselines.list.description: Learned starting context per agent, model and workspace (usage.md §2). `workspaceId` narrows to one workspace; on a hub without machineId or workspaceId: every online machine's baselines.

knowledge.sync.pull.description: Replication (knowledge.md §9.4), called by the hub over the node link. `pull` returns the items changed after `since` (exclusive, by HLC), oldest first, tombstones included. `storeId` names the node's knowledge database; a new one means it was replaced and the hub syncs everything again.

knowledge.sync.push.description: Merge items from other machines: last writer by HLC wins. `applied` counts the ones that were newer.

knowledge.promote.preview.description: What "Add to AGENTS.md…" would append to the workspace's root AGENTS.md: the picked items under a `## heading` section, as a unified diff. Reads only. Items already tagged `promoted`, inactive or outside the workspace's scope are listed in `skipped`.

knowledge.promote.description: Append the picked items to the workspace's AGENTS.md (creating it if missing) and tag them `promoted`. With the preview's `baseHash`, fails with `conflict` if the file changed since. Never commits.

route.suggest.description: Where should this prompt run? On a hub: across every online machine. On a node: its own workspaces. Explicit `@machine`, `#workspace` and `/agent` tokens win; otherwise the configured logprob classifier scores the targets. Read-only: nothing is started.

route.score.description: One option-logit readout through this machine's classifier (`MachineInfo.routing`). A hub without a classifier of its own borrows a machine's this way: the model only has to be reachable from that machine, not run on it. `probabilities` has one entry per option, normalized over the letters.

route.record.description: Record a routed prompt (the labeled eval set). Returns it with its id and time.

route.decisions.description: Recorded decisions, newest first; `overridden` filters; `before` (an id) pages. `total` counts the filter's matches.

route.rules.get.description: Routing rules (knowledge.md §9.3), tried in order; the first that matches applies. `set` replaces the list.

pipelines.list.description: Newest first; `workspaceId` narrows to pipelines started there.

pipeline.start.description: Validate the definition and start stage 1 (or wait at its gate). `title` defaults to the task's first line.

pipeline.gate.description: Answer the pending gate: approve starts the stage (`message` becomes `{{gate.message}}`), reject cancels the run.

pipeline.cancel.description: Stop the running stage's session and end the run as canceled.

pipeline.delete.description: Forget a run that isn't running or waiting; its sessions and worktree are kept.

container.create.description: A workspace of kind 'container' around a directory on the machine (adopted, or created with `create`). Nothing starts yet: the container is created and started by the first session. The image is `image`, else the repo's devcontainer.json, else bizzi's workspace image. `notes` lists devcontainer.json settings that were ignored.

container.stop.description: Stop the container now. Refuses while sessions are live unless `force` (which ends their agents).

session.forkTo.description: Fork a session onto another machine: push the workspace state (git branch plus uncommitted changes, or a shadow-git snapshot of a plain directory) to `toMachineId` and start a new session there seeded with a brief from this session's timeline. Served by the session's node; needs its hub link. Without a target, a git workspace lands in the target's workspace linked to this one (same project or `origin`) as a worktree on `branch` (default `fork/<source branch>-<id>`).

helper.start.description: Node-to-node, through the hub (`caller` stamped by the hub): start a helper whose parent runs on the caller's machine. Same guardrails as a local helper, applied with this machine's settings.

helper.send.description: The other helper tools for a cross-machine helper; only its parent (`parentId` on `caller`) may use them.

fork.prepare.description: Fork step 1 on the target: resolve where the fork lands and what the source may leave out of the bundle (`heads`: commits the target repository already has).

fork.receive.description: Fork step 2 on the target: apply the bundle, create the workspace or worktree, start the session with `brief`.

workspace.set.description: Set a workspace's user-owned fields: `name` renames it (bizzi's registry only, the directory is untouched), `color` and `icon` set its identity (`''` clears either). Emits `workspace.updated`.

pairing.create.description: Create a one-time pairing code for a new device or node.

themes.list.description: Custom themes (theming.md §5). Hub-stored so every device sees them; a node stores them locally.

prefs.get.description: User-wide preferences (theme choice, density); hub-local like themes.*. `prefs.set` merges and emits `prefs.updated`.

push.config.description: The hub's VAPID public key (base64url), the `applicationServerKey` for `pushManager.subscribe`.

push.register.description: Register (or move to this device) a browser push subscription; replaces any row with the same endpoint.

push.test.description: Send a test notification to this device's subscriptions.

session.info.description: Adapter-reported metadata changes (agent session id assigned, model switched, …).

turn.started.description: Emitted by the core when a turn starts; echoes the user input. `auto`: bizzi sent this input itself (continuing a turn cut off by a restart), not the user; it doesn't title the session and isn't the user's request. `agent`: the agent started this turn on its own, with no input from bizzi (Claude picking work back up when a background task finishes). Emitted by the adapter; `input` is empty.

turn.steered.description: Emitted by the core when input is steered into the in-flight turn.

turn.completed.description: Emitted by the adapter when the turn finishes, with the same turnId.

message.delta.description: `parentToolId` set when the text comes from a subagent started by that tool call.

approval.resolved.description: `by`: who resolved it. Adapters set it for resolutions that didn't come from approval.respond ('bizzi', 'agent', …); the core stamps 'user' (approval.respond) or 'parent' (the helper's parent session through the bizzi-agents tools, spec §12.5) with `bySessionId`.

question.asked.description: The agent asks the user something (Claude AskUserQuestion, Codex requestUserInput, MCP elicitation…). `text`/`options` summarize the first question for simple clients; `questions` carries the full form. Answer with `question.respond`.

context.updated.description: Current context-window occupancy (usage.md §1.2). Agents without data never emit it.

background.updated.description: The full set of background work the agent is running now (REPLACE semantics; `[]` when none is left). Only real activity: watchers and other ambient tasks are left out. Agents without the notion never emit it.

context.cleared.description: `session.clear` started a fresh conversation; `previousRef` is the agent session it left.

account.usage.description: Per-login usage observed during this session (rate-limit events etc.); the core republishes it globally.

session.restarting.description: The agent process is being replaced at a safe point (updates.md §5). The bizzi session carries on.

session.restarted.description: `ok: false` with `fallbackVersion`: the new version failed to start and the session resumed on the previous version (`fallbackVersion`) instead; it keeps running and stays stale.

login.prompt.description: Login sessions (`agent.login`): URLs / one-time codes detected in the terminal output.

agent.raw.description: Untranslated native event, always allowed; UIs render it generically.

prefs.updated.description: User-wide preferences changed (from `prefs.set` on any device); emitted by the server that stores them.

pipeline.updated.description: A pipeline run was started or changed (stage started or finished, gate opened or answered).

workspace.updated.description: A workspace's user fields changed (`workspace.set`): the whole new record.

AccountUsage.description: Per-login usage snapshot (usage.md §3.3). Merged per (agent, accountId) across machines; newest wins.

accountId.description: Stable account identity: email / account id, or an API-key fingerprint.

observedAt.description: ISO; the UI shows the age.

AgentCapabilities.description: What an agent adapter supports. UIs gate controls on this, never on the agent name.

terminal.description: Terminal mode: raw PTY in/out is available.

questions.description: The agent can ask the user structured questions (`question.asked` / `question.respond`).

backgroundTasks.description: The adapter emits `background.updated` (background work between turns).

account.description: e.g. account email or plan, when the agent reports it

method.description: How the binary appears to have been installed (recipe method name, e.g. 'installer', 'brew', 'npm').

onPath.description: Whether the binary is on the PATH of non-interactive shells (launchd/systemd/containers).

support.description: Whether bizzi supports this installed version (spec §7 "Supported versions"). Absent = not checked.

supportReason.description: Why `support` isn't 'ok', e.g. "OpenCode v1 is not supported; bizzi drives v2 only".

remedies.description: Confirmable fixes for `support` or for a non-preferred install method. Never run automatically.

preferredMethod.description: The recipe's preferred method on this OS (first in its method order).

realPath.description: Real path of the executable after resolving symlinks and wrapper shims.

billing.description: Billing class of the logged-in account (spec §12.3), when known.

staleSessions.description: Sessions on this machine whose agent process runs an older version than the installed one.

AgentProfile.description: Named start options for an agent: what the New session dialog fills in. Unset fields mean "the agent's own default". User-wide (stored with `UserPrefs`), so model ids are the agent's, not a machine's.

kind.description: upgrade: move to a supported version · migrate: switch to the preferred install method · restart-service: restart a stale shared server.

id.description: Recipe remedy id. Pass it as `remedy` to `agent.plan` / `agent.install` to run the remedy's own steps (e.g. a major-version upgrade) instead of the method's plain update.

command.description: Shell command shown to the user, when there's a single one.

message.description: Optional message to the agent (e.g. why it was denied).

editedInput.description: Replacement tool input, only when the request was `editable`.

input.description: The tool input the agent wants to use (command, file edit, …).

editable.description: Whether the adapter supports `editedInput` in the decision.

options.description: Decisions this agent supports for this request.

ApprovalResolution.description: How an approval ended: a decision, or 'cancelled' when its turn ended / the node restarted first.

BackgroundTask.description: What `SessionInfo.context` keeps of a `ContextUsage` (no breakdown). */ /** One piece of background work an agent is running (`background.updated`).

kind.description: What runs: a shell command, a subagent, a workflow, or something else the agent names.

description.description: The agent's one-line description ("Wait for PR checks to finish").

BillingClass.description: spec §12.3: metered = pay per token · plan = subscription windows · budgetless = inference you own.

BrowseEntry.description: A directory offered by the workspace picker (`fs.browse` / `fs.complete` / `fs.suggest`). Only directories and symlinks that resolve to directories are ever listed.

path.description: Absolute path on the machine (not symlink-resolved).

git.description: Has a `.git` entry (a repository root or a worktree).

workspaceId.description: Already registered as this bizzi workspace (compared by real path).

ContainerCommand.description: A shell command line (run with `sh -c`) or an argv.

ContainerLifecycle.description: persistent: stopped when idle, restarted on the next session · ephemeral: removed when idle, recreated fresh.

ContainerMount.description: An extra bind mount. `source` is a path as the Docker daemon sees it (the dind sidecar's filesystem).

ContainerState.description: Docker's container states, plus `absent` (not created yet, or removed) and `unreachable` (no daemon).

id.description: Docker's container id, when it exists.

liveSessions.description: Live (not ended or failed) sessions in the workspace.

idleUntil.description: When the idle timer stops or removes it, if it is running with no live session.

ContextBaseline.description: Starting context learned per (agent, model, workspace) from the first `context.updated` of earlier sessions (usage.md §2): "Codex starts at about 14k here". `tokens` is the median of recent samples.

samples.description: Samples behind the median (at most the last 10 kept).

updatedAt.description: ISO time of the newest sample.

ContextUsage.description: usage.md §1.2. `used` is the agent's own occupancy figure, never a sum of turns.

usable.description: Window minus the agent's compaction buffer, when known. Warnings key off this.

compactAt.description: Token count at which the agent compacts, when known.

categories.description: Only where the agent reports a breakdown (Claude); bizzi adds a 'bizzi' row for what it injects.

DensityPref.description: Density preference: a layout density, or `theme` to follow the theme's own.

machineId.description: For kind 'node': the machine it serves.

owner.description: The first device paired with the setup code.

Ed25519PublicJwk.description: Ed25519 public key as a JWK (`{ kty: 'OKP', crv: 'Ed25519', x }`).

ForkSessionSpec.description: The session a fork starts on the target machine.

ForkSource.description: What `fork.prepare` and `fork.receive` are told about the source workspace.

name.description: Source workspace name (default names on the target).

gitRemote.description: Normalized `origin` URL (linked-workspace match) and the raw one (set as `origin` on a fresh clone).

ForkTarget.description: Where a fork lands on the target machine: an existing workspace there, or a new directory.

toWorkspaceId.description: A git workspace on the target: the fork gets a worktree of it on a new branch.

toPath.description: A new (absent or empty) directory on the target; required for plain-directory workspaces.

ForkTransfer.description: How the workspace state traveled for a fork to another machine. `git`: the source branch plus any uncommitted or untracked changes as one snapshot commit on top, sent as a git bundle and checked out on `branch`. `snapshot`: a plain directory, committed into a shadow repository on each side.

commit.description: The commit the new session starts from.

branch.description: git: the branch created on the target machine.

sourceBranch.description: git: the source workspace's branch (absent when detached).

uncommitted.description: The snapshot commit includes changes that weren't committed in the source workspace.

bytes.description: Size of the bundle sent through the hub (0 when the target already had every object).

status.description: Porcelain v1 XY code, e.g. " M", "??", "A ".

diffRef.description: Pass to session_read `{ detail: 'diff', path }` for the diff.

HelperParent.description: What the target machine needs to know about a parent on another machine (`helper.start`).

depth.description: The parent's own depth (0 for a session you started).

projectId.description: The parent workspace's project and normalized `origin` URL: the helper's default workspace is the linked one.

HelperPendingItem.description: A pending approval or question of a helper, as its parent sees it.

title.description: Approval title, or the question's text.

input.description: Approvals: the tool input as JSON (truncated).

parentMay.description: What the parent may do: approvals 'allow' / 'deny'; questions 'answer' / 'cancel'.

note.description: Why the parent may not allow it (allowing stays with the user).

HelperReadResult.description: `session_read`: a structured summary of what a helper did since a cursor (spec §12.1, usage.md §2).

cursor.description: Pass as `since` next time to read only what's new.

transcript.description: detail 'full': the transcript in order (oldest entries dropped first to fit).

HelperSpent.description: Spend of a helper and every helper below it (usage.md §2): usd counts metered billing only.

HelperStartRequest.description: The `session_start` arguments, as sent to the target machine.

workspace.description: Workspace id or path on the target machine. Default: the one linked to the parent's workspace.

budget.description: Already capped by the parent's machine at what the parent's budgets have left.

reached.description: The `until` condition was met (false: timed out).

usage.description: Cross-machine waits: the helper tree's spend, so the parent's machine can count it toward budgets.

pending.description: With parentAnswersApprovals: what the helper waits on and what the parent may answer (session_answer).

target.description: Agent kind, or a tool name such as 'node'.

command.description: Shell command shown to the user (already quoted).

KeepAwakeMode.description: What keeps the machine awake: `off`; `turns`: a session is running a turn or a terminal session is busy; `turns_and_background`: also while a session has background work the agent is watching (`background.updated`).

KeepAwakeSettings.description: Per-machine keep-awake setting, stored on the node and set with `machine.set`.

onBattery.description: Also hold the machine awake on battery; false = only while on a power adapter.

KeepAwakeState.description: The node's keep-awake setting and hold (`MachineInfo.keepAwake`). Only idle system sleep is held, never the display.

supported.description: This OS has a backend. False: the setting is stored but does nothing here (shown as unavailable).

active.description: The machine is being held awake now.

turns.description: Sessions running a turn (or busy terminals) that count under the setting.

background.description: Sessions with background work that count under the setting (mode `turns_and_background`).

lingerUntil.description: Nothing counts any more, but the hold lingers until then (a follow-up may be on its way).

power.description: Last power source seen; absent when it isn't checked (unsupported OS, or nothing to hold).

pausedOnBattery.description: There is work to hold for, but the machine is on battery and `onBattery` is off.

kind.description: Memories only: fact | preference | decision | gotcha | procedure | reference | todo.

path.description: Absolute path of the workspace's AGENTS.md on its machine.

baseHash.description: Pass back to `knowledge.promote` so it fails if the file changed in between.

ids.description: Items that would be written, in order.

diff.description: Unified diff of the change (always an append at the end of the file).

warnings.description: E.g. the workspace has a CLAUDE.md, so Claude Code won't read AGENTS.md.

KnowledgeRecord.description: A knowledge item as it replicates between nodes through the hub (knowledge.md §9.4): the whole stored item, including its clock. Last writer by `hlc` wins; forgetting is a `deleted` tombstone.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock of the last change: `<15-digit ms>-<6-digit counter>-<machine id>`.

tag.description: `tag` scope: applies on every machine with this tag.

defaultAgentScope.description: Scope used when an agent writes without naming one.

overrides.description: Per source × scope overrides; shape owned by @bizzi/knowledge.

LabelColor.description: A palette name, not a CSS color: each theme resolves it (`--label-<name>`) so it reads on that theme's sidebar and cards, light or dark.

headful.description: A display/GUI session is available to agents (macOS Aqua session, or a virtual X display).

description.description: User-written paragraph about what the machine is for; part of the machine card (knowledge.md §9.2).

color.description: User-chosen identity color (spec §11.1 "Identity color"); set with `machine.set`.

lastSeenAt.description: Set by the hub: last time the machine's node was connected.

routing.description: This machine's node can reach a routing classifier (`BIZZI_ROUTER_URL`; the model may run elsewhere on its network). A hub without one of its own borrows it with `route.score`.

keepAwake.description: Keeping this machine from idle-sleeping while agents work (spec §8.1): the node's setting and what it is holding now. Absent from nodes that predate it.

MachineTarget.description: Routing to a machine (hub). Methods that name a session or workspace are routed by that id. Methods without one take an optional `machineId`: required when talking to a hub, ignored by a node when it matches its own machine (a different id → `not_found`).

label.description: Display name, when the agent gives one.

isDefault.description: The model the agent uses when none is given.

efforts.description: Effort levels this model accepts, when the agent says (a subset of the capability's `effort`).

NodeCaller.description: Who sent a node-to-node request; stamped by the hub, never trusted from the sender.

token.description: Token from /api/auth/token for a device of kind 'node'.

features.description: Optional link features this hub supports (e.g. HUB_FEATURE_NODE_REQUESTS). Absent on older hubs.

OrchestrationSettings.description: Guardrails for agent-to-agent helpers (spec §12.2). Per machine, optionally overridden per workspace.

onLimit.description: What `session_start` does beyond the concurrency limits.

parentAnswersApprovals.description: Let a parent answer its helpers' approvals (default: they go to you).

treeBudgetUsd.description: Optional metered-spend cap for a whole session tree.

code.description: One-time pairing code (or the setup code). Case-insensitive; dashes/spaces ignored.

machineId.description: For kind 'node': the machine id of the node being paired.

clientUrl.description: WebSocket URLs to use from now on.

PipelineInfo.description: A pipeline run (docs/pipelines.md): stages run one after another on one machine.

workspaceId.description: Where it was started; `where: 'workspace'` stages run here.

current.description: Index of the stage running, waiting at its gate, or that ended the run.

gate.description: Set while `status` is `waiting`: the stage about to start and why (its gate, or the run's budget).

worktreeId.description: The pipeline's worktree workspace, once created.

branch.description: Branch of the pipeline's worktree (default `pipeline/<title>-<id>`); only used when a stage runs `where: 'worktree'`.

budgetUsd.description: Metered spend cap for the whole run, checked before each stage; reaching it gates the next stage with reason `budget`.

summary.description: First line(s) of the stage's final message, at most 300 characters.

changedFiles.description: Files the stage changed (from its `file.changed` events).

PipelineStageSpec.description: One stage of a pipeline definition: an agent, a prompt template and where it runs.

name.description: Short unique name within the pipeline: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_` (`plan`, `implement`, `review`).

prompt.description: Prompt template. Placeholders: `{{task}}`, `{{gate.message}}`, `{{previous.name}}`, `{{previous.result}}`, `{{previous.diff}}`, `{{previous.files}}`, and `{{stages.<name>.result|diff|files}}` for any earlier stage.

where.description: workspace (default): the pipeline's workspace · worktree: the pipeline's own worktree, shared by every stage that picks it.

gate.description: Stop for your approval before this stage starts (an inbox item); approving can add a note (`{{gate.message}}`).

QuestionAnswers.description: Answers keyed by QuestionItem.id: an option label, several labels (multiSelect), or free text.

allowText.description: Free-text answer allowed (besides or instead of options).

RequestMsg.description: A client → server request; `params` follows the method.

ResponseOkMsg.description: A successful response; `result` is the `result:<method>` of the request with the same id.

probability.description: 0–1. A logprob readout for `classifier`; 1 for `explicit` and `single`.

RouteDecisionInput.description: One routed prompt and where it went, recorded by the one-pane composer (`route.record`). The labeled set for comparing classifiers (spec §11.2 "Choosing"): `text` → `chosen`, with what was offered and by whom.

text.description: The prompt as typed, routing tokens included.

candidates.description: What the suggestion offered, best first (may be empty).

via.description: suggested: sent to the top candidate · picked: another offered candidate · other: a target that wasn't offered.

overridden.description: `chosen` isn't the top candidate (false when nothing was offered).

source.description: explicit: `@machine` / `#workspace` in the text (combinable) left one target, or a few the user must pick from (`confident` false, e.g. `#acme-shop` on two machines) · single: only one target exists · classifier: a logprob readout over the targets · none: nothing decided (no classifier, it failed, or the tokens can't be satisfied: see `note`) · rule: a routing rule (`route.rules.get`) left one target, or a few to pick from when no classifier can choose. Whenever `confident` is false the client asks.

candidates.description: Best first, at most 3: the choices to offer when asking. Empty when nothing decided.

confidence.description: 1 − entropy / ln(N) over the targets scored; 1 for explicit and single.

confident.description: confidence ≥ the router's threshold: send without asking.

agent.description: Agent named with `/agent` in the text.

text.description: The prompt with the routing tokens it used removed.

offered.description: Targets offered to the classifier (online machines, at most the backend's option limit).

via.description: The machine whose classifier the hub borrowed (`route.score`); absent when the router's own scored.

letterMass.description: Share of the next-token probability that fell on option letters (low = the model wanted to say something else).

note.description: Why nothing was decided: no classifier, its error, several matches, or a token problem ("vps is offline", "no workspace matches @mac-mini and #bizzi").

rule.description: The routing rule that narrowed the targets (step 3), whatever then chose among them.

RoutingRule.description: A routing preference (knowledge.md §9.3), e.g. "production, prod logs → machines tagged prod-access". Matches when any of `match` appears in the prompt as a whole word or phrase, case-insensitive; a trailing `*` matches a word prefix (`prod*`). Exactly one of `tag`, `machineId`, `workspaceId` says where it goes.

agent.description: Agent to use when the prompt names none with `/agent`.

name.description: Environment variable name, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Values are never returned.

ServeReady.description: Printed by `bizzi serve` as a single JSON line on stdout once it is listening.

url.description: WebSocket URL of the client-protocol endpoint, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:7777/ws

SessionBudget.description: Only `metered` spend counts toward `usd`; budgetless providers count tokens only (usage.md §2).

agentSessionRef.description: The agent's own id for this conversation (Claude session id, Codex thread id, OpenCode session id).

forkedFromMachineId.description: Fork to another machine (topology.md §6): the machine `forkedFrom` runs on, when not this one.

spawnedBy.description: Agent-to-agent (spec §12.1): the parent session that started this helper.

spawnedByMachineId.description: Cross-machine helper (spec §12.4): the machine the parent (`spawnedBy`) runs on, when not this one.

scope.description: Helpers only. child: stops with its parent · detached: outlives it.

depth.description: 0 for sessions you start; parent depth + 1 for helpers (spec §12.2 depth limit).

agentVersion.description: Version of the agent process currently running this session (updates.md §2).

billing.description: Billing class of what the session runs on (spec §12.3).

budget.description: Optional cap for this session and its helpers (usage.md §2).

group.description: Fan-out group (spec §12): sessions you started together on the same task share this id.

seenThrough.description: Highest seq viewed on any device (spec §4); "done, not yet seen" = idle with lastSeq > seenThrough.

context.description: Latest context-window occupancy the agent reported (`context.updated`), without the breakdown, so lists (the sidebar tree) can show it for sessions nobody has open. Absent until the agent reports one.

background.description: Work the agent left running in the background between turns (`background.updated`): shell commands, subagents, workflows. Absent when there is none. Cleared whenever the agent process goes away, since the tasks die with it. Lists show such a session as still active (spec §11.1 "background").

parentAnswersApprovals.description: Helpers only: started while `parentAnswersApprovals` was on, so its parent may answer some of its approvals.

ThemeFile.description: A custom theme stored on the hub (theming.md §5); `data` is the theme JSON (shape owned by @bizzi/ui).

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over UTF-8 `authMessage(deviceId, nonce)`.

group.description: Windows that limit the same pool of models share a group (agy: "Gemini models", "Claude and GPT models", each with its own 5h and weekly window). Absent: the login has one pool.

UserPrefs.description: User-wide UI preferences (theming.md §5), stored on the server the client is connected to: the hub (shared by every device) or a node in local mode. Light/dark mode is not here: it stays per device.

themeId.description: Selected theme: a built-in id or a custom theme's id (`themes.list`).

uiFont.description: Interface font: a family name, or `system` for the platform font. Unset or '': `system`. Used when the device has it (JetBrains Mono ships with the UI), else the platform font.

codeFont.description: Code font (code blocks, diffs, terminals): a family name, or `system`. Unset or '': JetBrains Mono.

agentProfiles.description: Saved session-start profiles (`AgentProfile`). Each agent has a built-in Default profile (`defaultProfileId(agent)`), stored here only once edited; the others are user-created.

preferredProfiles.description: Per agent (an `AgentKind` key), the profile the New session dialog preselects. Unset: the Default profile.

tag.description: Notifications with the same tag replace each other (one per session, or per login for usage).

url.description: Absolute click-through URL (`<ui>/#/s/<sessionId>`), or relative to the service worker scope.

approval.description: Present when the notification is about exactly one pending approval.

WebPushSubscription.description: A browser push subscription, as `PushSubscription.toJSON()` returns it (keys base64url).

WidgetValue.description: A node-run widget's rendered value (usage.md §4). Widgets are data, never client-side code.

error.description: Set when the last run failed; the previous value (if any) is kept.

observedAt.description: ISO time of the last successful run; the UI shows staleness.

WorkspaceContainer.description: A container workspace's recipe. The workspace directory is bind-mounted at the same absolute path, so the agent's cwd and every path it prints match the machine's.

image.description: Image the container runs (for `build`, the tag bizzi builds it as).

imageSource.description: explicit: given at creation · devcontainer: from the repo's devcontainer.json · default: bizzi's workspace image.

build.description: devcontainer.json `build`: built on first start. Paths are absolute on the machine.

network.description: `bridge` (default), `none` (no network at all), or the name of a Docker network.

env.description: Fixed, non-secret environment set on the container (devcontainer.json `containerEnv`).

passEnv.description: Names of the node's environment variables forwarded into agent processes (agent credentials such as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`). Values are passed at exec time, never stored in the container's config.

user.description: User agents run as (`uid:gid` or a name); default: the node's own uid:gid.

postCreate.description: devcontainer.json `onCreateCommand`, `updateContentCommand`, `postCreateCommand`: run in order once after creation.

idleMinutes.description: Minutes without a live session before the container is stopped (persistent) or removed (ephemeral).

parentWorkspaceId.description: kind 'worktree': the repo workspace it was created from (UI groups it under that one).

branch.description: kind 'worktree': the branch checked out in it.

container.description: kind 'container': how its container is built and run (topology.md §7).

color.description: User-chosen identity color (spec §11.1 "Identity color"); set with `workspace.set`. A worktree without one shows its repo's.

icon.description: User-chosen icon in place of the name's first letter: one or two characters or an emoji (`isLabelIcon`).

WorkspaceKind.description: `container`: agent sessions run inside a container on this machine (topology.md §7).

tool.description: Set for non-agent tools (e.g. 'node'); `agent` is then the agent it was installed for.

params:agent.plan.description: `remedy`: an `AgentRemedy.id` from the listing; plans that remedy's steps (spec §7).

passEnv.description: Replaces the default list of forwarded credential variables.

bundleBase64.description: The git bundle (base64), absent when the target already has `transfer.commit`.

bundleRef.description: The ref inside the bundle that points at `transfer.commit`.

defaultAgentScope.description: Scope used when an agent writes without naming one.

overrides.description: Per source × scope overrides; shape owned by @bizzi/knowledge.

onBattery.description: Also hold the machine awake on battery; false = only while on a power adapter.

onLimit.description: What `session_start` does beyond the concurrency limits.

parentAnswersApprovals.description: Let a parent answer its helpers' approvals (default: they go to you).

treeBudgetUsd.description: Optional metered-spend cap for a whole session tree.

themeId.description: Selected theme: a built-in id or a custom theme's id (`themes.list`).

uiFont.description: Interface font: a family name, or `system` for the platform font. Unset or '': `system`. Used when the device has it (JetBrains Mono ships with the UI), else the platform font.

codeFont.description: Code font (code blocks, diffs, terminals): a family name, or `system`. Unset or '': JetBrains Mono.

agentProfiles.description: Saved session-start profiles (`AgentProfile`). Each agent has a built-in Default profile (`defaultProfileId(agent)`), stored here only once edited; the others are user-created.

preferredProfiles.description: Per agent (an `AgentKind` key), the profile the New session dialog preselects. Unset: the Default profile.

resumeRef.description: Resume an existing agent-native session (Claude session id, Codex thread id, …).

command.description: Terminal mode only: run this command (argv) instead of the agent's TUI.

group.description: Fan-out group id (spec §12), stored on the session; at most 128 characters.

prompt.description: Appended to the brief as the next instruction.

result:hello.description: `machine` is the node's machine (role 'node') or the hub's own host (role 'hub').

commands.description: Slash commands / skills the agent advertises.

prompt.description: What the session is waiting on, when known (terminal heuristics, login flows).

source.description: What produced this status, for the "explain" view (landscape.md §4.3), e.g. 'osc7501', 'detector:claude-permission', 'adapter'.
